cards.title: A commit is a snapshot
cards.body: `git commit -m "message"` saves everything staged as a commit. The message says what changed.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html
git add index.html
git commit -m "Add home page"

hi.title: Commit ek snapshot hai
hi.body: `git commit -m "message"` jo kuch staged hai use ek commit ki tarah save karta hai. Message batata hai kya badla.

cards.title: Good messages
cards.body: Write messages that finish the sentence "This commit will…": `Add home page`, `Fix the menu link`. Short and specific beats "stuff".

hi.title: Acche messages
hi.body: Aise messages likho jo "This commit will…" wala sentence poora karein: `Add home page`, `Fix the menu link`. Chhota aur saaf message "stuff" se behtar hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Git refuses this commit. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html
git add index.html
git commit "Add home page"

bug.fix: The message goes after `-m`: `git commit -m "Add home page"`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Git yeh commit lene se mana kar deta hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Message `-m` ke baad aata hai: `git commit -m "Add home page"`.

check.question: You run `git commit -m "Add logo"` with nothing staged. What happens?
options: Git says there is nothing to commit
check.explanation: A commit only saves what is staged. With nothing staged, there is nothing to save.

hi.question: Kuch bhi staged nahi hai aur aap `git commit -m "Add logo"` chalate ho. Kya hota hai?
options: Git kehta hai commit karne ko kuch nahi hai
Git phir bhi har file commit kar deta hai
Git aapke changes delete kar deta hai
hi.explanation: Commit sirf wahi save karta hai jo staged hai. Kuch staged na ho toh save karne ko kuch nahi.

exercise.prompt: Stage `index.html` and commit it with the message `Add home page`.
exercise.promptHi: `index.html` ko stage karo aur use message `Add home page` ke saath commit karo.

checks.labelHi: Ek commit `Add home page` kehta hai
